measures.label: Medi-Cal members enrolled in Partnership HealthPlan of California
measures.note: Published by the Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) in the Medi-Cal Managed Care Enrollment Report for September 2026; plan type County Organized Health Systems. The report publishes enrollment by plan and county only, with no county total and no statewide row, so each plan is its own measure, counties the plan does not serve are null, and California is null. Partnership HealthPlan of California serves 15 of the 17 counties: Butte, Colusa, Del Norte, Glenn, Humboldt, Lake, Mendocino, Shasta, Tehama, Trinity, Siskiyou, Sonoma, Marin, Sutter, Napa.
